verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API and PATs (notion-docs-1, notion-docs-2, notion-docs-12) theoretically allow pulling all pages/databases out programmatically, but there is no documented bulk/native 'export everything to open formats' feature in the evidence, and a hands-on user explicitly says 'it's hard to get stuff out of it, especially on mobile' (notion-comm-13), directly contradicting an easy full-data exit path.
